passages.title: Work Placement Information
text: Your two-week work placement at Hotel Seruni starts on Monday, 9 February. Please report to the staff entrance at the back of the building at 7.00 a.m. on the first day. Ms. Ratna Dewi, the training manager, will meet you there and take you to the orientation room. The orientation lasts about two hours. After that, you will be divided into three groups: front office, kitchen, and housekeeping.

Each group will change sections every four days, so everyone will try all three areas. Students in the kitchen group must wear the white uniform and safety shoes. Students in the other groups should wear the school's black uniform. Long hair must be tied back in all sections.

The hotel provides lunch for all students in the staff canteen at 12.30 p.m. You do not need to bring food, but you may bring a water bottle. Mobile phones must be kept in the lockers during working hours.

At the end of the placement, Ms. Ratna will give each student a short written evaluation. This evaluation will count as part of your Practical Skills score this semester, so please take every task seriously.
If you are sick or have an emergency, call me before 6.30 a.m. on the same day.

passages.title: The Lake Toba Nature Club
text: The Lake Toba Nature Club is a student organization at SMA Harapan Bangsa. It was started in 2019 by a group of students who loved hiking and wanted to protect the forests around their town. Today it has about forty members from grades 10 to 12.

The club meets every Wednesday afternoon in the biology laboratory. During the meetings, members plan activities, share photos of plants and birds they have seen, and learn basic skills such as reading maps and giving first aid. Once a month, the club goes on a day trip to a hill or a village near the lake.

The club's most popular project is the tree nursery behind the school. Members grow seedlings of local trees, such as pine and banyan, from seeds they collect themselves. When the seedlings are about thirty centimetres tall, the members plant them on bare hillsides with help from local farmers. Since 2020, they have planted more than 2,500 trees.

Not all activities happen outdoors. Every semester, the club organizes a short film evening about the environment and invites parents and other students. The money from snack sales at the event is used to buy tools for the nursery.

New members are always welcome. Students who want to join only need to attend two meetings and take part in one day trip. After that, they receive a green club scarf, which members wear proudly on every trip.

passages.title: Notice: Library Renovation
text: The school library will be closed from 2 to 20 March for renovation. During this time, the library will get new shelves, a larger reading area, and ten new computers for online research.

While the library is closed, a small book corner will be open in Room 14, next to the teachers' room, from 8.00 a.m. to 2.00 p.m. Students can borrow up to two books at a time from the book corner. Reference books and newspapers will not be available.
Books borrowed before 2 March can be returned to the box in front of the main office. No late fees will be charged during the renovation period.
We are sorry for the inconvenience. We hope the new library will be a more comfortable place for reading and studying.

options.B: The orientation room on the top floor
options.D: The staff entrance at the back of the building

questions.explanation: Informasi eksplisit (pemahaman tekstual): kalimat kedua paragraf pertama menyebut report to the staff entrance at the back of the building. Ruang orientasi adalah tempat yang dituju setelah dijemput Ms. Ratna.

questions.question:
Based on the email, decide whether each item is required or not required for a student in the kitchen group.
(1) Wearing safety shoes
(2) Bringing lunch from home
(3) Tying back long hair
questions.explanation: Kelompok dapur wajib memakai seragam putih dan safety shoes; rambut panjang harus diikat in all sections. Makan siang disediakan hotel (You do not need to bring food), jadi membawa bekal tidak wajib.

questions.question: Why does each group change sections every four days?

options.A: Because the hotel needs more workers in the kitchen
options.B: So that every student can experience all three areas
options.C: Because the training manager wants to test the students
options.D: So that students can choose their favourite section

questions.explanation: Hubungan sebab-akibat yang dinyatakan langsung: Each group will change sections every four days, so everyone will try all three areas.

questions.question: The word evaluation in paragraph 5 is closest in meaning to ....

options.A: a report that judges how well someone has done
options.B: a certificate that allows someone to work
options.C: a list of tasks that must be finished
options.D: a payment for the work someone has done

questions.explanation: Makna kata dari konteks: Ms. Ratna memberi short written evaluation yang dihitung sebagai nilai keterampilan praktik. Jadi evaluasi berarti penilaian tertulis tentang kinerja siswa.

questions.question: Which student is most likely to receive a poor evaluation from Ms. Ratna?

options.A: A student who brings a water bottle to the hotel
options.B: A student who uses a phone while serving guests at the front office
options.C: A student who calls Mr. Hendra at 6.00 a.m. because of a fever
options.D: A student who wears the black uniform in the housekeeping section

questions.explanation: Inferensi: ponsel harus disimpan di loker selama jam kerja, dan semua tugas harus dikerjakan serius karena dinilai. Membawa botol minum diizinkan, menelepon sebelum 06.30 adalah prosedur yang benar, dan seragam hitam memang untuk kelompok selain dapur.

questions.question: What do club members do during the weekly meetings?

options.B: Sell snacks to parents and students
options.C: Collect seeds in villages near the lake
options.D: Plan activities and learn basic skills

questions.explanation: Paragraf kedua: members plan activities, share photos ..., and learn basic skills such as reading maps and giving first aid. Kegiatan lain terjadi di luar pertemuan mingguan.

questions.question:
Which statements about the tree nursery are true according to the text?
(1) The seeds are collected by the club members.
(2) The seedlings are sold to local farmers.
(3) Local farmers help to plant the seedlings.
(4) Money from the film evening helps the nursery.
questions.explanation: Pernyataan (1) sesuai: from seeds they collect themselves. (3) sesuai: with help from local farmers. (4) sesuai: uang penjualan camilan saat pemutaran film dipakai membeli alat untuk persemaian. (2) salah: bibit tidak dijual, tetapi ditanam di lereng gundul.

questions.question: What is the main idea of paragraph 3?

options.A: The club's tree nursery helps to replant bare hillsides.
options.B: Pine and banyan are the best trees for hillsides.
options.C: Local farmers need help to plant more trees.
options.D: The club has more than forty members today.

questions.explanation: Paragraf 3 diawali kalimat utama The club's most popular project is the tree nursery, lalu menjelaskan proses dari biji sampai penanaman di lereng gundul. Pilihan lain hanya detail atau tidak dibahas di paragraf itu.

questions.question: Based on the text, what can we infer about the green club scarf?

options.A: It is given to every student who visits the club once.
options.B: It shows that a student has become an official member.
options.C: It is sold to raise money for the tree nursery.
options.D: It is worn only during the film evening.

questions.explanation: Syal hijau diterima setelah memenuhi syarat keanggotaan (dua pertemuan dan satu perjalanan), dan anggota memakainya dengan bangga. Jadi syal itu menandai keanggotaan resmi.

questions.question: The text is mainly written to ....

options.A: describe a student nature club and its activities
options.B: tell the history of Lake Toba
options.C: explain how to grow pine trees from seeds
options.D: persuade parents to watch environmental films

questions.explanation: Tujuan teks (inferensial): semua paragraf menggambarkan klub, kegiatan, proyek, dan cara bergabung. Teks ini termasuk descriptive text tentang sebuah organisasi.

questions.question: Where can students borrow books between 2 and 20 March?
questions.explanation: a small book corner will be open in Room 14, next to the teachers' room. Ruang guru hanya penunjuk letak.

questions.question:
Which of the following will students be able to do during the renovation period?
(1) Read newspapers in the book corner
(2) Borrow two books at the same time
(3) Return old books without paying a late fee

questions.question: A student needs an encyclopedia for a history project on 10 March. What is the best advice for this student?

options.A: Borrow it from the book corner in Room 14
options.B: Return it to the box in front of the main office
options.C: Look for it in another place, such as a public library
options.D: Wait until the new computers are installed on 10 March

questions.explanation: Ensiklopedia adalah reference book, dan pengumuman menyatakan Reference books ... will not be available selama perpustakaan ditutup sampai 20 Maret. Jadi siswa perlu mencari sumber lain. Soal ini menguji penerapan informasi pada situasi baru.

questions.question: Which sentence from the notice expresses the writer's hope, not a fact about the renovation?

options.A: The school library will be closed from 2 to 20 March.
options.B: Reference books and newspapers will not be available.
options.C: No late fees will be charged during the renovation period.
options.D: We hope the new library will be a more comfortable place for reading and studying.

questions.explanation: Evaluasi fakta/opini: tiga kalimat pertama berisi informasi yang bisa dipastikan (tanggal, ketersediaan buku, denda). Kalimat terakhir diawali We hope dan menyatakan harapan penulis.
